description: Land Acquisition - Dayigala, Dehiowita D/S Division, Kegalle District - Corrigeudum Notice to the Extra Ordinary Gazette No. 2203/31 of 26.11.2020
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including descriptions of land lots, locations, claimants, and compensation procedures. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
